command_guard_asks.title: Ask before destructive commands
command_guard_asks.description: Let command-guard ask before destructive commands (rm -rf, force push, reset --hard, and the rest); off by default. Denies of verifier bypasses such as git commit --no-verify always apply

inline_edit_max_lines.title: Inline edit limit (lines)
inline_edit_max_lines.description: Let the main thread edit repository files directly when one Write, Edit, MultiEdit, or NotebookEdit call changes at most this many lines; surface-guard sends bigger changes to construct:worker. 0 restores the old rule: the main thread writes only .vault/tasks/

iteration_cap.title: Iteration cap (failures)
iteration_cap.description: Deny a Bash command after it failed this many times for one agent, so the agent stops and reports instead of looping. A value that is not a whole number of 1 or more uses 3. 0 turns the cap off
